def simple_formula_value(formula, sheet, cache):
    """Evaluate simple formulas like =A3+1 used in the lookup year column."""
    if not isinstance(formula, str) or not formula.startswith('='):
        return formula
    expr = formula[1:].strip()
    m = re.fullmatch(r'([A-Z]+)(\d+)\s*([+-])\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', expr, re.I)
    if m:
        col, row, op, num = m.groups()
        ref = f"{col.upper()}{row}"
        base = cache.get(ref)
        if base is None:
            base = sheet[ref].value
            if isinstance(base, str) and base.startswith('='):
                base = simple_formula_value(base, sheet, cache)
        try:
            base = float(base)
            num = float(num)
            val = base + num if op == '+' else base - num
            if val.is_integer():
                val = int(val)
            cache[ref] = base
            return val
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

# Build a year -> row 14 value mapping from the Data sheet.
# In the workbook layout, years are headers in row 4; the desired Row 14 value
# is in the "Adjusted for Inflation" subcolumn immediately to the right.

for col in range(1, ws_data.max_column + 1):
    year = ws_data.cell(row=4, column=col).value
    if isinstance(year, (int, float)) and int(year) == year:
        value_col = col + 1 if col + 1 <= ws_data.max_column else col
        year_to_value[int(year)] = ws_data.cell(row=14, column=value_col).value

# Fill only Lookup!B2:B12

for row in range(2, 13):
    year_cell = ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=1)
    year = year_cell.value
    if isinstance(year, str) and year.startswith('='):
        year = simple_formula_value(year, ws_lookup, cache)
    if isinstance(year, (int, float)) and int(year) == year:
        ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=2).value = year_to_value.get(int(year), "")
    else:
        ws_lookup.cell(row=row, column=2).value = ""
